scientific_integrity: Exact analytic two-part theorem for one-seed exponential distance, with independent-arithmetic supplementary checker; distinguishes modeled success from population fitness and evolutionary outcome.
scientific_limitations: Scaled-band separation L>=9 is sufficient, not a sharp threshold; 2<L<9 not classified
Scaled habitat intervals have different absolute widths
No competition, kin effects, multigeneration evolution, demographic persistence or field calibration
title: Width uniformity versus a two-scale dispersal trap for exponential seed transport
